name: kotobase-storage-s3
description: Test-only harness deps. miniflare provides a real R2Bucket binding so r2-client is exercised against an R2 API implementation rather than a mock written to match it.

scripts.test: nbb --classpath "$(clojure -Spath -M:cljs-test)" test/run.cljs && nbb --classpath "$(clojure -Spath -M:cljs-test)" test/r2.cljs && npm run test:objects && npm run test:objects-r2 && npm run test:engine && npm run test:prolly-engine && npm run test:advanced && npm run test:bench-driver && npm run test:bench-worker
